title: Golly, whatten tunket’s yon guy in the mackintosh?
html_source:
Perhaps a reference to (or sighting of) the mysterious macintoshed fellow at Dignam’s funeral.

Gifford has “whatten tunket’s…” as “what in thunder is…” (from American slang).
